The badge at the top of our site reads Client Confidence Rating 2025 and shows no organization name; the rating was given in March 2026 for the 2025 calendar year, no fee was paid to be considered, and nothing is paid to display it. We reviewed the survey questionnaire before using the rating and have a reasonable basis to believe it is structured to make favorable and unfavorable responses equally easy and is not designed to produce a predetermined result. For clients living abroad, a non-US regulator such as the UK's Financial Conduct Authority may apply its own rules to our relationship; that is outside what this page covers.
